content: To be great is to be misunderstood.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: From Socrates to Galileo, every transformative mind was initially rejected or misunderstood by their contemporaries. Novel insight always appears strange to conventional thinking.
practicalInsight: Do not measure the value of your insight by the immediate comprehension of those around you.
reflectionPrompt: How can you remain steadfast in your core purpose even when others fail to understand your direction?
